outer_width = 80.1
outer_height = 80.1
length = 60.1
hole_diameter = 2.0
hole_radius = 6.25

solid_body = Box(outer_width, length, outer_height)

for i in range(4):
    angle = math.radians(i * 90)
    px = hole_radius * math.cos(angle)
    pz = hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, 0, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, length)

part = solid_body
part.name = "box_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
